title: scene-server: clear SceneRegion.activeCallId when its VTCCall ends
description: Oracle: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L418: "When the VTCCall referenced by `activeCallId` transitions to state `\"ended\"`, the server MUST clear this field to `null` and emit a `StateChange` for the SceneRegion type. This update is a side effect of the VTCCall state transition." Restated in jmap-scene-vtc-integration-guide.md L121-122. Not in JMAP-38uq.3 (scene L849-1340) or JMAP-8mem.6 (Chat.activeCallId only). Needs a VTC->Scene seam like the Chat binding in JMAP-8mem.6. Source: JMAP-x3lu audit.
acceptance_criteria: Ending a VTCCall bound to a SceneRegion sets that region's activeCallId to null and bumps SceneRegion state in the same backend operation; test covers ended via VTCCall/set and via auto-end.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: cross-layer bindings go in binding crates: crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server, crate-jmap-chat-scene-server, crate-jmap-scene-vtc-server. vtc-* and scene-* base crates stay independent of chat (RFC 8620 only); build their core parts now.
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); open-epic dependency only
